newsitem.title: UK: BOE allots 400 mln stg in outright bills, repo.
newsitem.headline: BOE allots 400 mln stg in outright bills, repo.

text.p: The Bank of England said it allotted 400 million stg to the money market, comprising 139 million in bills maturing on or before April 4 and 261 million in 6.0 percent repos to April 3 and 4.
This brought total liquidity provided to the market to 1.471 billion.
The Bank earlier revised its liquidity shortage forecast to 1.45 billion stg from the initial estimate of 1.5 billion.
